units.rawText: Ever since I came out of the factory, I've pursued speed. "Faster" is written into my base commands, and braking is almost a foreign concept to me…
units.displayText: Ever since I came out of the factory, I've pursued speed. "Faster" is written into my base commands, and braking is almost a foreign concept to me…

spans.text: Ever since I came out of the factory, I've pursued speed. "Faster" is written into my base commands, and braking is almost a foreign concept to me…

units.rawText: It was you, Professor, who taught me that the Oasis isn't the race grounds. I can afford to take it a bit slower here. So don't you worry about me, I'm just enjoying myself right now.

units.rawText: Not for the sake of glory or accolades, or the sound of empty cheers. It's nice to get some wind in your face occasionally, no?
